ink_definition: Maximum positive RGB channel increase above an exact zero-step production background exceeds12levels; threshold is descriptive, not a velocity or temporal motion test.
motion_evidence: This encoded-frame test measures trail ink and visual variation, not Lagrangian travel. The frozen river model and renderer integration kernel retain prior independent motion checks; this temperature movie does not turn model estimates into observed currents.
limitations: Encoded sampling is60frames at1/3second intervals, not exhaustive all600frames.
Permanent true-zero vectors, dry/source-unknown water and subpixel shoreline loss are retained rather than fabricated.
No physically matched surface/depth-average source handoff is claimed.
visual_assessment: Inspected actual encoded frames 0, 10, 150, 300, 450 and 590 around Carleton/Bayfield, plus the full river crop at frame 150. Both main Carleton branches and the Bayfield interior/mouths retain visible changing trails without a persistent channel-spanning artificial black gap. This visual gate applies to these target channels; recorded genuine zero-model/source-missing components elsewhere remain classified and unchanged.
retained_core_classification: Persistent no-ink core components elsewhere include exact zero model velocities, unavailable provider cells and a few small NOAA-provider patches. Raw descriptive counts and source masks remain intact.
